tools.name: create_user
tools.description: Create a user record in the confidential database. The record is stored in PostgreSQL on the per-app sealed /data volume — encrypted at rest under a key only the app owner controls; the host, the operator, and Privasys never see the plaintext.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Fetch a single user record by id from the confidential database.

id.description: The user id returned by create_user.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List all user records in the confidential database.
